blocks.text: Grade 9 高频词汇 701–800
ornamental /.ɒːnə'mentl/ n. 装饰物, 观赏植物；adj. 装饰性的, 装饰的, 观赏用的
Through these two pillars, Eleanor transformed the role of the First Lady from ornamental to activist.
中文语境：通过这两个支柱，埃莉诺将第一夫人的角色从装饰性角色转变为活动家角色
inertia /i'nəːʃə/ n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝；[化] 惯性
As for Congress, even Republican lawmakers were so appalled by the results of Hoover's inertia that they were ready to support the radical ideas of a Democrat in the White House.
中文语境：至于国会，就连共和党议员也对胡佛惰性的结果感到震惊，以至于他们准备支持白宫民主党人的激进想法
credibility /.kredi'biliti/ n. 可信用, 确实性, 可靠；[法] 证据能力, 可信程度, 确实性
Another theory that has recently gained credibility is that they landed on nearby Gardner Island.
中文语境：最近获得可信度的另一个理论是，它们降落在附近的加德纳岛
guinea /'gini/ n. 几内亚
They flew 22,000 miles across South America, Africa, India, and Southeast Asia until they finally landed in Lea, New Guinea.
中文语境：他们飞行了 22,000 英里，穿越南美洲、非洲、印度和东南亚，最终降落在新几内亚州的利
derivative /di'rivətiv/ adj. 引出的, 派生的；n. 引出之物, 派生物, 衍生字
Mirror Stage by CommonLit is a derivative of Wikipedia, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 2.0.
中文语境：CommonLit 的 Mirror Stage 是 Wikipedia 的衍生产品，已获得 CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 许可
chimpanzee /.tʃimpən'ziː/ n. 黑猩猩；[医] 黑猩猩
Wallon noted that by the age of about six months, human infants and chimpanzees both seem to recognize their reflection in a mirror.
中文语境：Wallon 指出，到大约六个月大时，人类婴儿和黑猩猩似乎都能认出自己在镜子中的倒影
decisive /di'saisiv/ adj. 决定性的, 坚定的, 果断的

In the first place, it has historical value as it marks a decisive turning point in the mental development of the child." In the second place, he claimed, it represents an essential connection between the person and his or her concept of identity.
中文语境：首先，它具有历史价值，因为它标志着儿童智力发展的决定性转折点。"其次，他声称，它代表了人与其身份概念之间的本质联系
component /kəm'pəunənt/ n. 元件, 组件, 成分；adj. 组成的, 构成的；[计] 组件
Many other psychologists disagreed with the notion that recognizing and processing one's reflection in the mirror was a key component in identity development.
中文语境：许多其他心理学家不同意识别和处理镜子中的倒影是身份发展的关键组成部分的观点
justify /'dʒʌstifai/ v.t. 替...辩护, 证明；v.i. 证明合法；[计] 段落重排, 两端对齐

After a few minutes of waiting, Jones announced that they had been a part of an experiment to demonstrate how people willingly create a sense of superiority over others, and how this can lead people to justify doing horrible things in the name of the state's honor.
中文语境：几分钟的等待后，琼斯宣布他们参与了一项实验，旨在展示人们如何自愿创造优于他人的优越感，以及这如何导致人们为以国家荣誉的名义做可怕的事情辩护
interception /,intə(ː)'sepʃən/ n. 拦截, 截断, 截住, 截取, 截击, 窃听, 侦听, 雷达侦察；[计] 截取, 窃听
Yes, I had thrown an interception earlier in the game, but since then I had been slinging the ball around pretty well.
中文语境：是的，我在比赛早些时候进行了一次拦截，但从那以后我的传球能力一直很好
lasso /'læsəu/ n. 套索, 以套索捕；v.t. 以套索捕
The play-call got signaled in: Gun Ace Right Z Motion 82 Lasso X Spot F Corner.
中文语境：比赛呼叫已发出信号：Gun Ace Right Z Motion 82 Lasso X Spot F Corner
camaraderie /.kæmə'rɑːdəriː/ n. 友情；同志之爱

Those who play football, particularly those who begin in their youth, are given a glamorized version of the sport - one where camaraderie , discipline, toughness and leadership are highlighted and the wretchedness is ignored and swept under the rug.
中文语境：那些踢足球的人，尤其是那些从年轻时就开始踢足球的人，被赋予了这项运动的美化版本--在这项运动中，友情、纪律、坚韧和领导力得到强调，而不幸的事情被忽视并被掩盖起来
luscious /'lʌʃəs/ adj. 甘美的, 浓厚的, 满足感官的
I also have a luscious mullet-mustache combo, play guitar, do yoga, hike, swim, golf, work out, read, and meditate.
中文语境：我还留着甜美的鲻鱼胡子组合，弹吉他、做瑜伽、远足、游泳、打高尔夫球、锻炼、阅读和冥想
assassin /ə'sæsin/ n. 暗杀者, 刺客；[法] 暗杀者, 行刺者
christen it Little Assassin,
中文语境：将其命名为小刺客，
sliver /'slivə/ n. 裂片, 薄片, 梳毛；v.t. 切成长片；v.i. 剖开, 分裂
the iron sliver I thought I'd die from.
中文语境：我以为我会死于铁条
discipline /'disiplin/ n. 训练, 纪律；v.t. 训练, 惩罚
the flames of discipline
中文语境：纪律之火
gouge /gaudʒ/ n. 圆凿, 用圆凿凿成的槽, 挖, 掘；v.t. 用圆凿削, 挖出, 欺骗
Taking two pins from her dress, Oedipus gouges his eyes out.
中文语境：俄狄浦斯从她衣服上取下两颗别针，挖出了自己的眼睛
prophesy /'prɒfəsai/ v. 预言, 预报
The Oracle prophesied that if Laius should have a son, the son would kill his father and marry his mother, Jocasta.
中文语境：神谕预言，如果拉伊俄斯生一个儿子，这个儿子就会弑父娶母伊俄卡斯塔
unrecognized /.ʌn'rekəgnaizd/ adj. 未被认出的, 未被认定的, 未被承认的
Here he encounters a chariot, driven by his (unrecognized) birth-father, King Laius.
中文语境：在这里，他遇到了一辆战车，由他（未被认出的）生父国王拉伊俄斯驾驶
entreat /in'triːt/ v. 恳求, 乞求
Jocasta, finally realizing Oedipus' true identity, entreats him to abandon his search for Laius' murderer.
中文语境：伊俄卡斯塔终于意识到俄狄浦斯的真实身份，恳求他放弃寻找杀害拉伊俄斯的凶手
monopolize /mə'nɒpəlaiz/ v.t. 独占, 垄断；[经] 垄断, 专营, 专利
Trujillo at this point was at his peak of power, monopolizing the Dominican economy.
中文语境：此时的特鲁希略正处于权力巅峰，垄断了多米尼加的经济
subsidy /'sʌbsidi/ n. 补助金, 津贴；[经] 补助金, 津贴, 补贴
Trujillo built his wealth by ruling the economy with shear force, monopolization, and government subsidies.
中文语境：特鲁希略通过用剪切力、垄断和政府补贴统治经济来积累财富
martial /'mɑːʃəl/ adj. 战争的, 军事的, 尚武的, 威武的；[医] 含铁的
This disaster led to the dictator declaring a state of emergency and martial law.
中文语境：这场灾难导致独裁者宣布进入紧急状态和戒严
brutality /bruː'tæliti/ n. 残忍, 无慈悲, 野蛮的行为
The country would not tolerate such brutality against women.
中文语境：这个国家不会容忍这种针对妇女的暴力行为
corrupt /kə'rʌpt/ adj. 腐败的, 贪污的, 讹误充斥的；v.t. 使腐烂, 腐蚀, 使恶化；v.i. 腐烂, 堕落
Female influence would result in international exposure of a corrupt dictator, pressure a scrambling Trujillo, and eventually lead to his assassination.
中文语境：女性的影响力将导致腐败独裁者的国际曝光，给混乱的特鲁希略施加压力，并最终导致他被暗杀
opera /'ɒpərə/ n. 歌剧
A Soap Opera from Hellas
中文语境：希腊肥皂剧
forfeiture /'fɒːfitʃə/ n. 没收物, 罚金, 丧失；[经] 没收, 没收物, 罚金

The significant loss of French presence in North America might have benefitted Native Americans at one point, but the forfeiture left this territory open to British (and later American) expansion and rule.
中文语境：法国在北美的存在的重大损失可能一度使美洲原住民受益，但这种丧失使这片领土向英国（以及后来的美国）扩张和统治开放
reimburse /.riːim'bəːs/ v.t. 付还, 偿还, 赔偿；[经] 偿付, 赔还, 付还; 偿还
Pitt turned command of recruitment and supplies over to local authorities in America and promised to reimburse them for their efforts.
中文语境：皮特将招募和补给的指挥权移交给了美国地方当局，并承诺补偿他们的努力
allay /ə'lei/ v.t. 使平静, 使缓和

But the spirits of the slain are to be satisfied in either of two ways; the first is by the spilling of the blood of the nation by which they fell; the other by covering the bodies of the dead , and thus allaying the resentment of their relations.
中文语境：但是被杀者的灵魂可以通过两种方式得到满足：第一个是导致他们倒下的国家的鲜血流淌；另一个是覆盖死者的尸体，从而减轻他们亲属的怨恨
throe /θrəu/ n. 剧痛, 阵痛；[医] 剧痛
Meanwhile, England was in the throes of civil war.
中文语境：与此同时，英国正处于内战的阵痛之中
rare /rєə/ adj. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的；adv. 非常
Still, many vacancies do occur during a president's term of office, and the rarest and most important of these are the seats on the Supreme Court.
中文语境：尽管如此，在总统任期内确实会出现许多空缺，其中最稀有和最重要的是最高法院的席位
spendthrift /'spendθrift/ n. 浪费的人；adj. 浪费的, 挥霍无度的
A spendthrift is forbidden to exercise administration over his own goods.
中文语境：禁止挥霍者管理自己的财产
oratory /'ɔrətəri/ n. 演讲, 雄辩术, 演讲术, 雄辩
They practiced the skills of rhetoric and oratory to persuade other members of the ruling body.
中文语境：他们练习修辞和演讲技巧来说服统治机构的其他成员
aristocrat /'æristəkræt/ n. 贵族
In Roman society, the aristocrats were known as patricians.
中文语境：在罗马社会，贵族被称为贵族
virgin /'vəːdʒin/ n. 处女；adj. 处女的, 贞洁的, 纯洁的, 初始的, 纯的
Females shall remain in guardianship even when they have attained their majority (except Vestal Virgins).
中文语境：女性即使已成年（维斯塔贞女除外），仍应受到监护
spearhead /'spiəhed/ n. 矛尖, 先锋队, 先头部队；v.t. 做先锋, 带头
The nuclear weapon was developed after a massive, secret research project spearheaded by the United States government.
中文语境：核武器是在美国政府牵头的一项大规模秘密研究项目之后开发出来的
fascism /'fæʃizm/ n. 法西斯主义, 极端国家主义
Meanwhile, fascism swept Italy and Germany.
中文语境：与此同时，法西斯主义席卷了意大利和德国
long-range adj. 远程的, 远大的, 长期的；[化] 远程的; 长距离的; 长期的; 长远的
Germans developed rockets that could travel great distances, creating a new era of long-range warfare.
中文语境：德国人研制出可以远距离飞行的火箭，开创了远程战争的新时代
ample /'æmpl/ adj. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的
Refugees often end up in poor countries and small countries that don't have ample resources to support them.
中文语境：难民往往最终来到贫穷国家和没有足够资源支持他们的小国家
shipbuilding /'ʃipbildiŋ/ n. 造船
Importantly, positions of power often required not only free time but also finances to fund municipal projects such as shipbuilding and festivals.
中文语境：重要的是，权力职位往往不仅需要空闲时间，还需要资金来资助造船和节日等市政项目
demo /'deməu/ n. 演示, 样本唱片；[计] 演示
The word democracy derives from the Greek demos , which referred to the entire citizen body.
中文语境：民主一词源自希腊语 demos ，指的是整个公民团体
stipulation /.stipju'leiʃən/ n. 约束, 约定, 契约；[经] 订定, 规定, 条款
Sometimes, though, they had a minimum property stipulation for attendees (as in the Boeotia federation).
中文语境：但有时，他们对参加者有最低财产规定（如维奥蒂亚联盟）
mercenary /'məːsinəri/ n. 唯利是图者, 雇佣兵；adj. 为钱而工作的, 被雇的, 图利的
Unlike his father, who had to rely on mercenaries in the First Punic War, Hannibal swelled his ranks with Carthaginians, Gauls, Spaniards, and Libyans who hated Rome.
中文语境：与他的父亲在第一次布匿战争中不得不依靠雇佣兵不同，汉尼拔与憎恨罗马的迦太基人、高卢人、西班牙人和利比亚人一起壮大了自己的队伍
depose /di'pəuz/ v.t. 免职, 废黜, 作证；v.i. 作证, 供证
Fabius was then deposed and the armies were given two new leaders who followed Rufus' policy of action in the field.
中文语境：法比尤斯随后被废黜，军队任命了两位新领导人，他们遵循鲁弗斯的战场行动政策
enmity /'enməti/ n. 敌意, 憎恨
According to legend, Hannibal's father, Hamilcar Barca (the great Carthaginian general of the First Punic War) made his son swear an oath of enmity towards Rome for life.
中文语境：据传说，汉尼拔的父亲哈米尔卡·巴尔卡（第一次布匿战争中的迦太基大将）让他的儿子发誓终生与罗马为敌
vilify /'vilifai/ v.t. 诽谤, 贬低；[法] 诋毁, 中伤, 诽谤
When demonising the "rogue" behaviour of an enemy state, it's easy to vilify its citizens or tar them all with the same brush.
中文语境：当妖魔化敌国的"流氓"行为时，很容易诽谤其公民或一并抹黑他们
apathetic /.æpə'θetik/ adj. 缺乏感情的, 无动于衷的, 缺乏兴趣的；[医] 无情[感]的, 淡漠的
Some support their government; others are apathetic or downright sceptical, and some even leave in search of a better life.
中文语境：有些人支持他们的政府；有些人则支持他们的政府。其他人则冷漠或完全怀疑，有些人甚至离开去寻找更好的生活
remit /ri'mit/ v.t. 宽恕, 赦免, 免除, 汇出, 缓解, 减轻, 把...提交, 使恢复原状, 推迟；v.i. 缓解, 汇款；n. 移交的事物
Many remit money back to their families in the north via brokers.
中文语境：许多人通过经纪人将钱汇回北方的家人
hagiography /.hægi'ɒgrəfi/ n. 圣徒传, 圣徒言行录

This group has produced all the major works dramatizing the personal histories of the leaders, including the "Immortal History" ( Pulmyŏl ŭi Yŏksa ) and "Immortal Leadership" ( Pulmyŏl ŭi Hyangdo ) series, which constructed the official hagiography of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il, respectively.
中文语境：该小组创作了所有描写领导人个人历史的主要作品，包括《不朽的历史》（Pulmyŏl ŭi Yŏksa）和《不朽的领导》（Pulmyŏl ŭi Hyangdo）系列，分别构建了金日成和金正日的官方圣传
prose /prəuz/ n. 散文；v. 写散文；adj. 散文的, 平凡的

Difficult to access and written in a highly stylized, dogmatic prose, North Korea's domestic propaganda is not only largely ignored abroad, but it's also difficult for even South Koreans to understand.
中文语境：朝鲜的国内宣传难以接触，而且是用高度程式化、教条主义的散文写成的，不仅在国外很大程度上被忽视，而且连韩国人也很难理解
paradigm /'pærədaim/ n. 范例, 式样, 词形变化表, 纵聚合关系语言项
Obedience - in the Milgram paradigm at least - is not only a matter of the subordinate's relationship to the authority figure.
中文语境：服从--至少在米尔格拉姆范式中--不仅仅是下属与权威人物的关系问题
synthesize /'sinθisaiz/ v. 综合, 合成
Using his original data and backed up by research at Yale University's archives, we synthesized data from 21 of his experimental conditions, involving 740 participants in all.
中文语境：利用他的原始数据并得到耶鲁大学档案研究的支持，我们综合了他的 21 个实验条件下的数据，总共涉及 740 名参与者
coerce /kəu'əːs/ v.t. 强制, 强迫

Ironically, because they were isolated in an experimental laboratory, Milgram's subjects lacked the advantage available to others in the world outside when they are being coerced and pressured to obey.
中文语境：具有讽刺意味的是，由于米尔格拉姆的实验对象被隔离在实验实验室中，因此当他们受到胁迫和压力时，他们缺乏外界其他人可以利用的优势
irreparable /i'repərəbl/ adj. 不能修补的, 不能挽回的；[法] 不可弥补的, 不可挽回的
They argue that changing river patterns disrupted the farming and trading systems and eventually led to irreparable flooding.
中文语境：他们认为，河流格局的变化扰乱了农业和贸易系统，并最终导致了无法挽回的洪水
figurine /'figjuriːn/ n. 小雕像
Clay figurines of goddesses, for example, are proof that religion was important.
中文语境：例如，女神的泥塑就证明了宗教的重要性
drainage /'dreinidʒ/ n. 排水；[医] 引流[法], 导液[法], 排水[设备]
Sophisticated drainage systems throughout the city carried dirty water and sewage outside of living spaces.
中文语境：整个城市的复杂排水系统将脏水和污水排到生活空间之外
sanitary /'sænitəri/ adj. 卫生的；n. 公共厕所
The findings clearly show that Harappan societies were well organized and very sanitary.
中文语境：研究结果清楚地表明哈拉帕社会组织良好且非常卫生
textile /'tekstail/ n. 纺织品, 纺织业；adj. 织的, 纺织的
Pottery, textiles, and beads are evidence of skilled craftsmanship and thriving trade.
中文语境：陶器、纺织品和珠子是熟练工艺和繁荣贸易的证据
conjure /'kʌndʒə/ v.t. 念咒文召唤, 变戏法, 想象；v.i. 变戏法, 施魔法
The phrase "early civilizations" usually conjures up images of Egypt and Mesopotamia and their pyramids, mummies, and golden tombs.
中文语境："早期文明"一词通常会让人想起埃及和美索不达米亚及其金字塔、木乃伊和金色坟墓
predate /'priː'deit/ v.t. 倒填...的日期, 把...的日期填早, 在日期上早于, 在日期上先于；[经] 提前日期
Most African tribes had a noble class, and slavery in Africa predates the written record.
中文语境：大多数非洲部落都有一个贵族阶级，非洲的奴隶制早于有文字记录
hallmark /'hɑːlmɑːk/ n. 纯度检验证明, 品质证明；v.t. 加盖纯度检验证明
Powerful Kingdoms, beautiful sculpture, complex trade, tremendous wealth, and centers for advanced learning - all are hallmarks of African Civilization on the eve of the Age of Exploration.
中文语境：强大的王国、美丽的雕塑、复杂的贸易、巨大的财富和高等学习中心--所有这些都是大航海时代前夕非洲文明的标志
primarily /'praimərili/ adv. 主要地, 首先地
Although primarily an agricultural people, West Africans held many occupations.
中文语境：虽然西非人主要是农业民族，但他们也从事多种职业
intellectual /.intə'lektʃuəl/ n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者；adj. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
